$comment: Gilda's Model Market (Port Meridian, Q1.A): a Copilot-app-only mechanic. You hire a model (Auto, or a category's model with an effort) for each job on her board, paying starfish; the grade (right-sized, over, short) is the game's, against the course's guidance on models and reasoning effort. The jobs, prices, refunds, stamps, quotes and Gilda's lines are the pack's market.json; the model list is models.json; this file is the market's words: the overlay, the hire's name, each outcome's summary, the stall's signs and Wingman's hints.

text.summary.quick-right: {who} did the job for {paid} starfish: right-sized.
text.summary.quick-over-model: {who} did the job, but it cost {paid} starfish for a {fair}-starfish job.
text.summary.quick-over-effort: {who} did the job, but High effort cost {paid} starfish for a {fair}-starfish job.
text.summary.hard-right: {who} got it done: right-sized for a hard job.
text.summary.hard-short-auto: Auto made a start, but with its effort hidden, the job isn’t done.
text.summary.hard-short-model: {who} made a start, but a Lightweight model isn’t enough for this job.
text.summary.hard-short-effort: {who} made a start, but it needs more effort for this job.
text.interact: Hire a model at Gilda’s Model Market
text.retryModelNotice: Retry with a different model: same job, and you don’t write it again.
text.retryEffortNotice: Retry with more effort: same job, and you don’t write it again.
text.hint1: Read the job first, Captain. A quick look doesn’t need a big model. A hard job wants more muscle and effort.
text.hint2: I’ll mark a hire that fits each job. Open Gilda’s work order and look for the glow.
text.hint3: Quick looks: Auto, or a Lightweight model on its default effort. Hard jobs: a Powerful model, or a Versatile one on High effort.
text.speaker: Gilda:
text.title: Gilda’s Model Market
text.sub: Hire a model for the job. Bigger models cost more starfish.
text.specialText: the app chooses a model for your task.
text.short: You’ve got {n}. Auto and Lightweight cost {price}, or find more starfish round the islands.
text.noRefundOver: Job done, no refund: you paid for more than it needed.
text.noRefundShort: No refund. Retry costs a new hire, but you won’t write the job again.
text.announceBoard: Gilda’s Model Market. You have {n} starfish to spend. Pick a job, 1 to 4.
